name: stone-soup-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Stone Soup, a Python framework for target tracking and state
estimation: it provides transition, measurement, control and clutter models, predictors and updaters
(Kalman, extended, unscented, particle, information, ensemble and other filter families), and the
tracking components built on them.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is Stone Soup's state-estimation models, predictors and updaters: the stonesoup/models package (transition, measurement, control and clutter models), the stonesoup/predictor package and the stonesoup/updater package, together with their API pages docs/source/stonesoup.models.rst, docs/source/stonesoup.models.clutter.rst, docs/source/stonesoup.models.control.rst, docs/source/stonesoup.models.measurement.rst, docs/source/stonesoup.models.transition.rst, docs/source/stonesoup.predictor.rst and docs/source/stonesoup.updater.rst, the tutorials docs/tutorials/01_KalmanFilterTutorial.py, docs/tutorials/02_ExtendedKalmanFilterTutorial.py and docs/tutorials/03_UnscentedKalmanFilterTutorial.py, and the module, class and function docstrings and property descriptions of those three packages.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and
